settings.whyBuiltBody:
We're a merch company — that's what we're known for. But we wanted to do something DIFFERENT.

Hustle & Heart is our love letter to everyone grinding through hard days. You are not alone. You are loved. 💛

— Joey, BeaTrackFam
settings.supportDesc: 988, Crisis Text Line, DV Hotline — always here
settings.supportBody:
If you're struggling, please reach out. You matter.

988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline: call or text 988
Crisis Text Line: text HOME to 741741
National Domestic Violence Hotline: 1-800-799-7233 or text START to 88788
